action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} al colpo, 5 ft, 1 target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1 + 3}) danni perforanti.

trait.name: Arctic Camouflage
entries: The ermine's snow-white coat grants it a degree of camouflage in snowy terrain. When in snow or ice, creatures have disadvantage to see the ermine.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The ermine has advantage on Wisdom({@Perception Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Tight Squeeze
entries: The long, skinny body of an ermine allow sit to move easily through even tiny spaces, squeezing through spaces as small as 1 inch.
